label: Updated at 8 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Scheffler Leads FedEx St. Jude
items.text: Scottie Scheffler finished the FedEx St. Jude Championship at 13-under, two shots ahead of Sam Burns and Sungjae Im at 11-under.

items.headline: LeBron James Launches Golf Channel
items.text: LeBron James started a YouTube golf channel, debuting with a video playing alongside former Cavaliers teammates as he documents his golf journey.

items.headline: Extreme Heat Impacts Memphis Event
items.text: Triple-digit temperatures at TPC Southwind caused players to use umbrellas, handheld fans, and multiple gloves/shirts for the FedEx St. Jude Championship.
